coordinateSystem.description: Planning coordinates centered on the map; verify against World Builder before placement.

combatZones.purpose: close-to-mid infantry flanking around the left VP
combatZones.coverPlan: staggered hedgerows and low stone walls with at least two deliberate gaps
combatZones.losPlan: broken sightlines; no continuous firing lane toward either base
combatZones.vehicleRule: one readable through-route plus one wider turning pocket

combatZones.purpose: main combined-arms contest around the central VP
combatZones.coverPlan: limited green cover at diagonal approaches; open/red-risk crossing at the VP
combatZones.losPlan: two non-garrison LOS blockers offset from the road axis
combatZones.vehicleRule: continuous main road with no decorative choke narrower than the planned road

combatZones.purpose: mobile flank and medium-range engagements around the right VP
combatZones.coverPlan: spaced orchard rows, fences and ditches that allow lateral movement
combatZones.losPlan: partial foliage screens; preserve readable firing pockets
combatZones.vehicleRule: country-road route and a separate infantry gap through the orchard edge

landmarks.garrisonPolicy: maximum one candidate garrison after base-fire and dominance checks
rotational counterpart; maximum one candidate garrison

terrainPlan.baseGround: muted summer grass and compacted soil
secondaryRoads: country road beside the orchard in lane_right
terrainPlan.heightRule: gentle agricultural undulation only; no unverified combat-dominating high ground
terrainPlan.softEdge: dense field boundary, distant tree line and non-interactive farm dressing outside the playable area

designNotes: Uses the project default 384x384 terrain and 320x320 playable area.
Uses three lanes and three victory points from the approved project spec.
Gameplay points use 180-degree rotational symmetry for the first graybox timing pass.
European countryside and the default three-lane structure were confirmed by the user on 2026-08-19.
Exact asset paths, cover stamps, building garrison status, sector polygons and supply adjacency remain subject to World Builder verification.
